$comment: One loop per venture that has one, written as a closed cycle: the last stage feeds the first or it is not a loop. A play is worth doing here in proportion to how much of its venture's loop it turns, which is the only reason this file exists — a rating that cannot say what a play feeds is a ranking of tactics against each other rather than against the business.
$sourceComment: The loop shape is Reforge's: inputs run through a process that produces an output which is reinvested as the next input, and a loop beats a funnel because a funnel needs new fuel poured in at the top every time. https://www.reforge.com/blog/growth-loops
$costComment: Every stage here is zero-budget by construction. A stage that would need money, an account, a credential or an approved scope is recorded with status blocked and the exact missing thing; it never becomes a plan to spend. Unblocking one is an owner action in docs/NEEDED.md, not a code change.

loops.name: Edition to reader, reader to reader
loops.input: One Czech AI edition a day, already produced.

stages.label: Publish the edition
stages.output: A dated page, its Atom feed entries and its JSON endpoints.

stages.label: Turn a reader into a returning reader
stages.output: A subscriber who gets the next edition without having to remember the site.
stages.blockedBy: No email provider, list or subscribe form exists. DNESKAi's only retention surfaces today are the Atom feeds, which are a weaker version of this stage and cannot be measured.

stages.label: Give the reader one thing worth passing on
stages.output: A Brief or a Watchlist line a reader sends to one other person.

stages.label: The send lands in front of somebody who does not follow us
stages.output: A new reader arriving at the edition.

loops.name: Fight week to reader, reader to reader
loops.input: Verified card coverage in the days around a UFC or Oktagon event.
loops.$ventureStatusComment: MMA Files is paused by operations-2026-09a. The loop is recorded because the issue asks for it and because a paused venture resumes with one switch; no stage of it runs while the venture is paused.

stages.label: Publish the fight-week article
stages.output: A dated Czech article with its verified card data.

stages.label: Put the same card in front of the Czech MMA audience where it actually is
stages.output: A post on the largest measured Czech network, sent on in group and direct conversation.
stages.blockedBy: No Facebook channel, page, credential or approved scope exists. Facebook stays in the plan because 67 % of Czech internet users are regular users of it; it stays unexecutable because nothing here can post to it.
stages.ownerAction: docs/NEEDED.md — decide the MMA Files Facebook page

stages.label: A reader arrives before the next card
stages.output: A returning reader for the following fight week.
stages.blockedBy: Downstream of two stages that do not run.

loops.name: Free lesson to learner, learner to learner
loops.input: One bilingual carousel package a day about devShark's free learning.

stages.label: Draft the day's package
stages.output: A carousel and its captions, owner-approved before anything leaves the repository.

stages.label: Send the reader to something free and finishable
stages.output: A devShark lesson or path a stranger can complete without paying or registering interest.

stages.label: The learner finishes something worth showing
stages.output: A completed path, its merchandise reward, and a screenshot the learner owns.

loops.name: Edition to follower, follower to reach
loops.input: One deterministic bilingual edition a day, rendered and held.

stages.label: Render the day's edition
stages.output: Czech and English packages with their carousel panels.

stages.label: Publish it to the edition's own account
stages.output: A post on an account a developer follows for the signal rather than for us.
stages.blockedBy: The four Instagram and Threads accounts do not exist and only the owner can create them; both editions are state: held in config/ventures.json.
stages.ownerAction: docs/NEEDED.md — create the four Instagram and Threads accounts

stages.label: One developer sends it to another
stages.output: A send or a reply, which is the only route to somebody who does not follow the account.
stages.blockedBy: Downstream of an account that does not exist.

loops.name: Post to reader, reader to reader
loops.input: The owner's own writing, planned by the desk and written and posted by the owner.

stages.label: Plan the day's post
stages.output: A deterministic recommendation the owner may take or ignore.

stages.label: The owner posts it
stages.output: A post in the owner's own voice on the owner's own account.

stages.label: A reader reaches the book or the audiobook
stages.output: A reader at okraj.shop, from facts the owner supplied rather than claims the desk made.

loops.name: Play to result, result to prior
loops.input: One weekly brief and the plays in it.
loops.$kindComment: An efficiency loop in Reforge's sense, not an acquisition one. GoVIRAL has no audience of its own and is not going to be given one; what compounds here is how good the next brief is, and pretending otherwise would put a follower target on a room that cannot post.

stages.label: Write the week's brief
stages.output: Rated plays with the readings behind them.

stages.label: The owner runs one of them
stages.output: A post that happened, on a surface the owner controls.

stages.label: Record what it did
stages.output: A measured result that either supports a prior in config/goviral-distribution-priors.json or contradicts it.
stages.blockedBy: Nothing in this repository reads back what a post earned; no analytics scope is approved and none is being requested here. Until a result is recorded by hand, the loop turns on the owner's own reporting.
stages.ownerAction: docs/NEEDED.md — decide how a play's result gets back into the priors

loops.name: Deck to summary, summary to template
loops.input: Every delivered article and package that needs a rendered deck.

stages.label: Render the deck
stages.output: Panels, and the bounded summary written beside the delivery.

stages.label: Read the summaries back as a family
stages.output: Which template families are actually being asked for.

stages.label: Improve the template the decks keep needing
stages.output: A template every venture's next deck inherits.
